current.label: CURRENT FBS POWER RATING
current.measures: Current team-strength research view: this season’s opponent-adjusted play-level results, blended with measured carryover, roster/talent and verified availability, in points against an average FBS team on a neutral field.

state.label: PRODUCTION PRICING STATE
state.artifact: football/cfb_p4/engine.js strength state, replayed from football/cfb_p4/params.js
state.measures: The latent trained state currently feeding the pricing engine: a long-run state trained through 2025, carried into this season, updated game by game, and blended with a this-season-only track on a learned curve.
state.why_priced: It is the Layer-1 team-strength mean of the governance champion (edgedesk_cfb_p4_v1.0.0), walk-forward tested on 2022–2025.
